target_definitions.A_first_board: future_promotion: same episode reaches at least one higher board within next five observed sessions
target_definitions.B_second_board: future_stage_leader: largest future board gain among same-stage candidates, requiring gain >=2; verified theme leader unavailable
target_definitions.C_third_board: future_market_leader: tied highest future board among current 1-3 boards within horizon, requiring future max >=5

limitations: features and labels are reconstructed after the fact, not a contemporaneous archive
candidate universe is not complete and has survivorship risk
topic membership is unavailable, so B is not a verified topic-leader label
future five-session labels use the observed feature-date sequence and are not independently calendar-verified
proxy path fields are inferred daily OHLC marks and have zero actual fills
TopK hit/precision is identity evidence, not executable trade win rate
